mapper.select: SELECT todo.BOOKSET_ID, todo.HAPPEN_DATE, todo.BOOK_DATE, bookdate.BOOKSET_DATE, bookset.STANDARD_CCY, todo.TASK_ID, task.TASK_PRI, lay.busi_id as finprodId, lay.BUSI_DETAIL_TYPE as finprodType, lay.BRANCH as branch, lay.BOK_DETAIL_ID as bokDetailId, lay.LAYERING_ID as layeringId FROM BOK_BATCH_TASK_TODO todo LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bookset ON todo.BOOKSET_ID = bookset.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_DATE bookdate ON todo.BOOKSET_ID = bookdate.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_ACCT_LAYERING_INFO lay ON todo.BOOKSET_ID = lay.bookset_id LEFT JOIN SYS_BATCH_TASK task ON task.TASK_ID = todo.TASK_ID WHERE 1=1 AND todo.SEQ_NO = #{seqNo} AND todo.BOOKSET_DATE = #{BOOKSET_DATE} AND todo.BOOK_DATE = #{BOOK_DATE} AND todo.HAPPEN_DATE = #{HAPPEN_DATE} AND todo.TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND bookset.ACCT_MODE = '03' AND todo.IS_SUB_BOOKSET = #{IS_SUB_BOOKSET}
